mapper.select: select rv.rv_no, rv.rv_point, rv.rv_content, rv.rv_reg_date, rv.r_no, rv.u_no, u.u_name, ri.rvimg_no, ri.rvimg_img from ( select * from ( select rv_no, rv_point, rv_content, rv_reg_date, r_no, u_no from r_review where r_no = #{r_no} order by rv_reg_date desc ) where ROWNUM <= 3 ) rv JOIN users u on rv.u_no = u.u_no LEFT JOIN r_review_img ri on rv.rv_no = ri.rv_no order by rv.rv_reg_date desc, ri.rvimg_no

select rv.rv_no, rv.rv_point, rv.rv_content, rv.rv_reg_date, rv.r_no, rv.u_no, u.u_name, ri.rvimg_no, ri.rvimg_img from r_review rv JOIN users u on rv.u_no = u.u_no LEFT JOIN r_review_img ri on rv.rv_no = ri.rv_no where rv.r_no = #{r_no} order by rv.rv_reg_date desc, ri.rvimg_no
mapper.delete: delete r_review where rv_no = #{rv_no} and u_no = #{u_no}
